    """
    Marshal's complete multipart upload request based on *uploaded_parts*.

    :param uploaded_parts: List of all uploaded parts, ordered by part number.
    :return: Marshalled XML data.
    """
        return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <CompleteMultipartUpload>
        <Part>
            <PartNumber>{}</PartNumber>
            <ETag>{}</ETag>
        </Part>
    </CompleteMultipartUpload>""".format(
            uploaded_parts[0].part_number, uploaded_parts[0].etag
        )

def xml_marshal_list_multipart_uploads(uploads):
    """
    Marshal's list multipart uploads request based on *uploads*.

    :param uploads: List of all uploads.
    :return: Marshalled XML data.
    """
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ListMultipartUploadsResult>
    <Bucket>{}</Bucket>
    <KeyMarker>{}</KeyMarker>
    <UploadIdMarker>{}</UploadIdMarker>
    <NextKeyMarker>{}</NextKeyMarker>
    <NextUploadIdMarker>{}</NextUploadIdMarker>
    <Delimiter>{}</Delimiter>
    <MaxUploads>{}</MaxUploads>
    <IsTruncated>{}</IsTruncated>
    <Upload>
        <Key>{}</Key>
        <UploadId>{}</UploadId>
        <Initiated>{}</Initiated>
    </Upload>
</ListMultipartUploadsResult>""".format(
        uploads[0].bucket,
        uploads[0].key_marker,
        uploads[0].upload_id_marker,
        uploads[0].next_key_marker,
        uploads[0].next_upload_id_marker,
        uploads[0].delimiter,
        uploads[0].max_uploads,
        uploads[0].is_truncated,
        uploads[0].key,
        uploads[0].upload_id,
        uploads[0].initiated,
    )
